messages:
megan: quick UX thread  debate: should invoice rows expand inline to show line-items, or link out to a separate ledger view? prototyped both.
ryan: inline expansion is faster for quick checks but can blow up the page for invoices with lots of line items.
yasmin: ledger view is cleaner for heavy accounting use. but it interrupts flow for support folks who just want the first 3 lines.
chris: how about a hybrid: show first 3 line-items inline + a "View full ledger" link that opens ledger panel. keeps pages tidy.
megan: i like hybrid. add a compact "Show more" control that progressively loads more lines (infinite scroll) to avoid rendering huge DOMs.
ryan: permission question: should non-billing users see amounts? security requested masking for non-finance roles. e.g., show "—" or blurred numbers with tooltip "Restricted".
yasmin: masking might cause confusion. better: surface amounts only for billing-admin and admins, for other roles show partial view with token counts but not $ totals.
chris: actionable copy: show a small badge "Restricted" with tooltip explaining who can request access. add a link to request permission.
megan: export behavior: when users click "Export line-items" from expanded row, should we export only whats visible or the full ledger? suggestion: default to full ledger but show a checkbox "Export visible only".
ryan: agree. UX: in the export modal show a summary: invoices included, lines included, estimated rows, file format choices. include filename template example.
megan: proposed filename template for project exports: `redwood_invoice_<org>_<project>_<YYYY-MM>.zip` — thoughts?
yasmin: include slug normalization (lowercase, dashes) and warn about long names truncating. example in modal helps.
chris: accessibility: expanded inline rows must be keyboard-collapsible, with `aria-expanded` on the parent row and focus returned to the trigger when closed. screen reader text should read "Invoice 2025-03, expanded showing 3 of 28 line items".
yasmin: also use `role=region` and `aria-label` with invoice id and scope so NVDA users can jump.
billing-bot: Note: backend can stream CSV for large exports. UI should show "Streaming export" toast and a progress indicator. For queued exports >2000 rows, we already email link when ready.
megan: copy tweak: primary button in invoice row currently says "Download" — change to two explicit actions inline: "Download PDF" and "Export line-items (CSV)". keep a kebab menu for additional actions.
ryan: mobile layout: expanded rows on small screens should become a full-screen panel, not inline accordion, to avoid cramped space.
yasmin: plus ensure blurred/masked amounts have an accessible label e.g., "Amount hidden for your role" so screen readers know.
chris: UX micro-copy: the permission request flow should say "Request billing access" and show estimated approval SLA (e.g., 2 business days). reduces support pings.
megan: i'll update the prototype with: hybrid inline (first 3 lines) + "View full ledger", progressive load, masking behavior for non-billing roles (tokens visible, $ masked), explicit export modal with filename examples, mobile full-panel expansion, and accessibility ARIA notes. figma link: https://figma.com/file/invoice-lineitems-hybrid (pinned).
yasmin: i'll run a quick permissions edge-case review once updated.
chris: no objections. looks practical.
billing-bot: UX checklist added to ticket: keyboard support, aria-expanded/labels, export summary, streaming/queue behavior.
megan: thanks all, i'll add tickets for dev and a11y and move to backlog. :+1:
